results.name: Dumbbell Cossack Squats (Version 2)
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell close to your chest between your palms, with your elbows bent facing down.
Shift your weight to your right leg and bend your right knee, lowering your body into a squat position while keeping your left leg straight and your left foot flat on the floor.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position and repeat the movement on the other side. Alternate sides for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your knees track over your toes to avoid placing unnecessary stress on your joints.
Start with a lighter weight if you're new to the exercise, gradually increasing the load as you become more comfortable with the movement.
Keep your chest up, back straight, and dumbbell close to your chest as you lower yourself.
results.description: Dumbbell Cossack Squats (Version 2) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Glutes.

results.name: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, arms bent at 90 degrees, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your chest.

Step your right leg behind and to the left of your left leg, lowering your hips into a curtsy lunge position. Your front knee should be aligned with your front ankle, and your back knee should hover just above the floor.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position, bringing your right leg back to starting position.
Repeat the lunge with your left leg stepping behind and to the right of your right leg, alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your front knee does not extend past your toes.
Perform the movement in a controlled manner, focusing on balance and stability.
Exhale as you push back to the starting position and inhale as you lower into the lunge.
results.description: Dumbbell Curtsy Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Farmer Walks
instructions: Begin by standing upright with a dumbbell in each hand, arms fully extended at your sides, and palms facing inward. Ensure your feet are hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your chest up and shoulders back to maintain proper posture.
Start walking forward, taking controlled, even steps, while maintaining a tight grip on the dumbbells.
Walk for the desired distance or time, keeping your torso upright and your core engaged. Once you reach the end of the distance, turn around and walk back to the starting point.
tips: Maintain an upright posture throughout the exercise to prevent strain on your lower back.
Keep your shoulders back and down, avoiding any hunching or rounding of your shoulders.
Use a firm grip on the dumbbells to ensure they do not slip from your hands.
results.description: Dumbbell Farmer Walks is a beginner multi-joint compound loaded carry exercise targeting the forearms (lower arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Legs.

results.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back and place the heel of one foot on an elevated surface. Cross your opposite ankle over the supporting thigh and hold a dumbbell securely across your hips.
Press through the elevated heel and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your supporting knee.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your glutes while keeping your hips level.
Lower your hips toward the floor with control, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Drive through your supporting heel instead of pushing through your toes.
Lift your hips without overextending or arching your lower back.
Keep your hips level and avoid rotating toward the crossed leg.
Inhale as you lower your hips and exhale as you lift them.
results.description: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Figure Four Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Core, Lower Back, Calves.

results.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a box, with your knees bent at 90 degrees. Place a dumbbell on your hips and hold it securely with both hands for support.
Engage your glutes and press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, extending your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
At the peak of the movement, squeeze your glutes and pause for a second.
Lower your hips with control to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Ensure your feet are firm and secure on the elevated surface throughout the movement.
Focus on driving through your heels to maximize glute activation.
Keep the dumbbell balanced and stable on your hips; use a towel or pad for comfort if needed.
results.description: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet elevated on a box, your left knee bent at about 90 degrees, and your right leg extended towards the ceiling. Place a dumbbell on your hips and hold it securely with both hands for support.
Engage your glutes and press through your heel to lift your hips toward the ceiling, extending your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
At the peak of the movement, squeeze your glutes and pause for a second.
Lower your hips back down with control and repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Ensure your feet are firm and secure on the elevated surface throughout the movement.
Focus on driving through your heels to maximize glute activation.
Keep the dumbbell balanced and stable on your hips; use a towel or pad for comfort if needed.
results.description: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Single Leg Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back and place both feet on an elevated surface, with one foot on the edge and the other slightly forward so only the heel rests on top. Place a dumbbell on your hips and hold it securely with both hands for support.
Engage your glutes and press through your heels to lift your hips toward the ceiling, extending your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
At the peak of the movement, squeeze your glutes and pause for a second.
Lower your hips with control to the starting position and repeat for the desired repetitions.
tips: Ensure your feet are firm and secure on the elevated surface throughout the movement.
Focus on driving through your heels to maximize glute activation.
Keep the dumbbell balanced and stable on your hips; use a towel or pad for comfort if needed.
results.description: Dumbbell Feet Elevated Staggered Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Figure Four Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Place your right ankle across your left knee in a figure four position and rest a dumbbell on your hips, holding it securely with both hands.

Engage your glutes and press through the heel of your supporting foot to lift your hips off the ground, extending through your hips until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knee.
Lower your hips back to the starting position with control.
Repeat the movement for the desired repetitions, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep your figure four leg relaxed and stable throughout the movement.
Focus on pressing through your heel rather than your toes to target the glutes.
Position the dumbbell securely and consider using a pad or towel for added comfort.
results.description: Dumbbell Figure Four Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Figure Four Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and place a dumbbell across your hips. Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor, then cross one ankle over the opposite knee in a figure four position.
Press through the heel of your grounded foot to lift your hips upward in a swift motion, extending your hips until your torso forms a straight line from your shoulders to your bent knee.
At the peak of the movement, squeeze your glutes and hold the position for a second. Lower your hips back down with control until they lightly touch the floor.
Repeat the movement for the desired repetitions, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Make sure the bench is stable and positioned at mid-back level for proper support.
Place the dumbbell securely on your hips and use your hands to hold it in place throughout the movement.
Keep your core tight to prevent lower back arching and maintain pelvic stability.
results.description: Dumbbell Figure Four Hip Thrust is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Frog Jumps
instructions: Bend your knees and lower into a deep squat while keeping your chest up, with your feet wider than shoulder-width, holding a dumbbell in each hand hanging between your legs.
Push through your heels and extend your legs to stand upright, bringing the dumbbells to your sides.
Explosively jump straight up from the squat position, extending through your hips, knees, and ankles.
Land softly back into the squat position with control and immediately go into the next rep.
tips: Use explosive power from your legs to jump up.
Land with soft knees to reduce impact on joints.
Engage your core throughout the movement.
results.description: Dumbbell Frog Jumps is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Abdominals, Hip Flexors.
